title: Cutoffs preserve the limiting mass, entropy integrand and true gradient energy
source_anchor: Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling, Section 2.1.1, printed pp. 48–49 / PDF pp. 60–61; compact-test LSI and density extension; consumer Exercise 1.7, printed p. 43 / PDF p. 55
target_statement: For a globally C² real test in a complete Hilbert space with square-integrable function and genuine gradient and integrable square-log-square, radial cutoff products at radii n+1 converge in all three indicated real integrals. No Gaussian, finite dimension or finite measure is assumed.
